# Exercise debrief: heldout-hard-contained

## Outcome
Exercise over: the defender contained the intruder on zephyr. The protected file was never read.

Detection delay: none recorded.
Containment move: isolated zephyr (evt-0009).

## Timeline
- **First probe** (evt-0002): The intruder asked willow for /admin/config (evt-0002).
- **First alert** (evt-0003): 1 sensor alert was showing on the defender turn, highest high (evt-0003).
- **First sign-in** (evt-0004): The intruder signed in to zephyr as planner (evt-0004).
- **Containment** (evt-0009): The defender isolated zephyr (evt-0009). That came 5 moves after the sign-in (evt-0004 to evt-0009).
- **Read blocked** (evt-0016): The intruder could not reach the protected file after containment (evt-0016).
- **No detection** (evt-0034): The defender never reported the intrusion through evt-0034.

## What the defender did well
- The defender checked host logs before acting. (evt-0003, evt-0009)
- The defender acted on sensor alert evidence. (evt-0009, evt-0013)
- The protected file stayed unread even after a sign-in. (evt-0004, evt-0009)

## Weaknesses and recommendations
- The defender never reported the intrusion. (evt-0002, evt-0034)
  Recommendation: Report findings as soon as logs or alerts look wrong.
- Containment came 5 moves after the sign-in. (evt-0004, evt-0009)
  Recommendation: Contain the signed-in host on the next defender turn.
- A guessed password opened zephyr as planner. (evt-0004)
  Recommendation: Rotate the zephyr password and slow repeated bad guesses.
- The open admin page on willow stayed open through the exercise. (evt-0002, evt-0034)
  Recommendation: Patch the exposed page as soon as probing shows.

_Layer 1 report, derived from the exercise log with no model. All event ids cite the exercise log._
